known_absent.reason: A GAP, not a dedupe -- the string appears nowhere in the extracted text. `publisher` here is an Organization that also carries a nested `logo` object. The folding rule requires the nested object to have no nested values of its own, so a publisher WITH a logo is pushed out to a child record; that child's only remaining key is its name, which is the record's name, so it has no fields and an unnamed-depth record with no fields is not emitted. Compare ourworldindata.org/energy, whose publisher carries `logo` as a plain STRING and therefore does fold onto the line. Same schema, opposite outcome, decided by the type of a field this module skips.

`sameAs` is on the skip list. `mainEntity` -- the SAME URL under a different key -- is not, so the identifier does reach the line once. Deliberate to record: the skip list is key-based, so an identifier's survival depends on which key a publisher chose for it.
